title: Driver Intelligence & Sign-in Update
headline: More accurate driver checks, more reliable desktop sign-in, and safer system controls.
changes: Driver Intelligence now separates comparable driver versions from Windows device health, so working devices are not incorrectly shown as unknown.
Desktop sign-in now uses dedicated request limits and cancellable polling with backoff.
Removed the retired Process Manager and CPU C-States control while preserving existing Windows settings and recovery history.
Simplified slider cards by removing the desktop-only “Real” badge.
Fixed website sign-out to send the required security token and show an error if sign-out fails.
